Extract the notice:

ZZ173 to BLR now ETD 18:10 local, was 16:40. Crew out of hours, standby crew called. Gate stays B9. 212 pax booked.

json.system: You extract structured data from airline operations messages. Use only what the message says. If a value is not stated, use null. Times are local, 24-hour HH:MM.

schema.description: One airline operations message about a single departing flight, as structured data.

flight_number.description: Carrier code ZZ then digits, no space, e.g. ZZ173

status.description: on_time if the departure time is unchanged (a gate change alone is still on_time)

new_departure_local.description: New local departure time HH:MM, or null if unchanged or unknown

gate.description: Departure gate, or null if none

reason.description: Short reason in plain words, or null if none given

passengers_affected.description: Booked passengers, or null if not stated

content.text: {"flight_number": "ZZ173", "status": "delayed", "new_departure_local": "18:10", "gate": "B9", "reason": "Crew out of hours; standby crew called", "passengers_affected": 212}
